units.source_text: 她仿佛另装上去个脸似的怪诞。

en.t: She looked grotesque, as though another face had been fitted onto her.

units.source_text: 好像村里人通过女人显露出一张脸似的。

en.t: It was as if the villagers were showing a face through the woman.

units.source_text: 在这之前，村落应该是单方面的行刑者。

en.t: Until then, the village should have been the one-sided executioner.

units.source_text: 或者是没有意志的食肉植物，贪婪的海葵。

en.t: Or else a carnivorous plant without a will, a ravenous sea anemone.

units.source_text: 他只是偶然上了他们的当，不过是个可怜的牺牲者。

en.t: He had merely fallen into their trap by chance, nothing more than a pitiable victim.

units.source_text: 可要是让村落方面说，被抛弃的当然是自己这一方。

en.t: But if the village were allowed to speak, naturally it would say that they were the ones who had been abandoned.

units.source_text: 在道理上当然不可能被外界说三道四。

en.t: In principle, of course, outsiders had no right to criticize them.

units.source_text: 而且，他若成为那些加害者中的一个碎片，那么，他们就会维持原状，冲着他龇牙咧嘴。

en.t: And if he became one fragment among those perpetrators, then they would remain as they were and bare their teeth at him.

units.source_text: 他还从没有这样考虑过自己和村落的关系。

en.t: He had never before thought of his relationship with the village in this way.

units.source_text: 他的笨拙狼狈也是理所当然的。

en.t: So his clumsy discomposure was only natural.

units.source_text: 所以说，他就此退下，就像他主动放弃了自己的正当性。

en.t: That was why, if he backed down here, it would be as though he had voluntarily abandoned his own rightful position.
